owner directive: Record the two SU(2) constants that sit inside their bars, then use that pair on the pion decay constant.
BH-1: lbar_1 and lbar_2 are the D-wave sum rule of Pennington and Portoles, hep-ph/9409426, equations (16), (24) and (27), at lambda = 1. The rho is the frozen KSRF resonance: g = 2 pi, m_rho^2 = 8 pi^2 F^2, Gamma = (pi m_rho / 12) (1 - 4 M_pi^2/m_rho^2)^(3/2). F is the chiral-limit decay constant M_Q sqrt(N_c)/(2 pi), M_Q = m_p/3, N_c = 3. M_pi is the charged-pion leaf. The system is lbar_1 + 4 lbar_2 - 53/8 = 1440 pi^3 F^4 a_2^0 and -lbar_1 + lbar_2 + 97/120 = 288 pi^3 F^4 b_1^1. The bars are Colangelo, Gasser and Leutwyler 2001: lbar_1 = -0.4 ± 0.6, lbar_2 = 4.3 ± 0.1. These constants are not rows of the 91. The precision binary is not rebuilt.
